name: jeti-lang
description: Syntax highlighting and language support for Jeti — a statically-dispatched Objective-C dialect

jeti.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `jeti-lsp` executable. A bare name is resolved against `PATH`, after checking the workspace's own `target/debug/jeti-lsp` and `target/release/jeti-lsp` (so working inside the Jeti repository needs no configuration). Build it with `cargo build -p jeti-lsp`.

jeti.searchPaths.markdownDescription: Directories passed to the server as `--include`, used to resolve `#import`. Relative entries are resolved against the workspace folder; the directory of each open document is always searched first.

jeti.arc.markdownDescription: Analyze in ARC mode (the compiler's default). Turn this off for projects built with `-fno-jeti-arc` (manual retain/release), so the editor stops reporting `explicit 'release' not allowed in ARC mode` for code that builds. The setting is passed to the server as `-fno-jeti-arc`.

jeti.arguments.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for the language server, using `jetic`'s own spellings. Only the switches that change diagnostics are understood: `-fno-jeti-arc`, `-fno-checker`, `-eh legacy`. Anything else (build output paths, `-g`, …) is ignored — the editor never links or runs code.
